How to Play Let's Pillow Fight!{KP}Pick up pillows and hit your opponents with lots of them!{KP}To pick up a pillow, face it and press the Circle button!{KP}Move with the directional buttons to dodge your opponents' pillows!{KP}Hold the X button while moving to move fast!{KP}Get hit by a pillow and your score goes into the minus!{KP}Hit someone with a shining pillow, aka the Golden Pillow, for lots of points!{KP}Think back to your school trip and have fun!
